title: EADA Business School Undergraduate Scholarships 2026-2027
legacy_titles: Scholarship for Academic Excellence (naming used on the official Global BBA Fees and Funding page for the award the official 2026-2027 scholarship PDF names 'Scholarship for Excellence')
program_type: University merit scholarship awarded at admission and applied as a tuition-fee discount
funding_type: Tuition fee remission only (percentage discount on annual tuition, university-funded)
administering_authority: EADA Business School (Fundación Privada Universitaria EADA), Admissions Department / Bachelor Division
implementing_agency: EADA Business School Admissions Department (same body; the scholarship application is submitted to the EADA admissions route and results are issued with the admission decision)
programme_action: EADA undergraduate merit scholarship scheme, 2026-2027 fee year: Scholarship for Excellence, Global Student Scholarship, Junior Talent Scholarship, Athletic Scholarship and Spanish Bachillerato Academic Excellence Scholarship
description: EADA Business School in Barcelona awards merit-based scholarships to candidates applying to its undergraduate programmes, covering between 10% and 25% of the 2026-2027 programme fee. The published award types are the Scholarship for Excellence (10-25% of the annual tuition for each year the student spends at the Barcelona Global BBA Campus), the Global Student Scholarship (10-25% of the annual tuition for the academic year of application, for candidates who have lived in several countries during their schooling years), the Junior Talent Scholarship (a fixed 25% of the annual tuition for the academic year of application, for candidates with exceptional extracurricular activities or outstanding professional experience), the Athletic Scholarship (10-25% of the annual tuition for each year at the Barcelona Global BBA Campus, for high-performance or professional athletes) and the Spanish Bachillerato Academic Excellence Scholarship (for students with a final Bachillerato grade of 8.5/10 or higher). Applicants must apply for the scholarship together with their bachelor's application, and the award is applied as a discount against the final pending tuition payments of the programme rather than paid as cash.

programme_structure.renewal_criteria: Coverage of 10-25% of the annual tuition applies 'for each year that students spend at the Barcelona Global BBA Campus' for the Scholarship for Excellence and the Athletic Scholarship, so those awards are renewable across the Barcelona years of the programme. The Global Student Scholarship and the Junior Talent Scholarship are published as covering only 'the academic year of application'. Separately, EADA guarantees the same tuition fee as the year of enrolment throughout the entire 4-year duration of the programme, and recipients must maintain a GPA of 3.5 or higher.
programme_structure.intake: September intake. The Global BBA is published for the Fall 2027 intake with a start date of 2 September 2027 and a duration of 4 years; the published admission rounds for that intake run from 11 December 2026 to 30 July 2027. The scholarship scheme currently published on the official site is titled 'Scholarship for September 2026 intake (undergraduate programmes)' and prices against the 2026-2027 programme fee.

status_label: Open - rolling admission, apply at any time
status_note: EADA states that it follows a rolling admission policy for its Bachelor Programmes, allowing applicants to submit their applications at any time, with admission rounds every 15 days (typically Fridays) and weekly rounds in August. The published scholarship scheme (10-25% of the 2026-2027 programme fee) remains the live scheme on the official site. The cycle currently advertised for new applicants is the Fall 2027 Global BBA intake, whose published admission rounds begin on 11 December 2026. The 15% early-bird discount for enrolment before 31 December 2025 has already passed and is not a scholarship.
verification_notes: Verified directly against nine official eada.edu sources: the 2026-2027 EADA Scholarship Application Undergraduate Programmes PDF (downloaded and text-extracted), the standalone scholarship application form PDF, the Global BBA Fees and Funding page, the Global BBA Admissions page, the Global BBA programme page, the Undergraduate Programmes page, the site home page, the press/media-kit page (logo assets) and the site sitemap. Award names, the 10-25% coverage range, the per-award bands, the separate application requirement, the one-week rule, the one-scholarship-per-candidate maximum, the non-stacking rule, the 2-week enrolment condition, the GPA 3.5 condition and the full Fall 2027 admission-rounds calendar were all read from official pages. Not confirmed: the Early Action / EA1 / EA2 / RD round labels, which do not appear on the official EADA pages (EADA publishes dated rolling rounds instead), and any published ranking, number of scholarships per round, or weighting of selection criteria.
source_last_updated: Not published as a dated revision on the fetched pages; the Global BBA pages are published for the Fall 2027 intake and the site carries a 2026 copyright notice.

application_deadline.deadline_timezone: Europe/Madrid (CEST, UTC+02:00) - EADA is based in Barcelona and all published round and enrolment dates are Barcelona local dates; no time-of-day cutoff is published
application_deadline.typical_application_window: Rolling and year-round. EADA admits on a rolling basis with admission rounds every 15 days (typically Fridays) and weekly rounds in August. The published admission rounds for the Fall 2027 Global BBA intake run from 11 December 2026 to 30 July 2027, each followed by an enrolment deadline. Because the scholarship deadline is defined relative to the candidate's own bachelor's application, the binding date differs for every applicant.
application_deadline.application_period: Applications may be submitted at any time under the rolling admission policy. The scholarship application itself must be submitted within one week of completing the online bachelor's application, i.e. before the admission result is issued.
application_deadline.official_rule: Official rule from the 2026-2027 scholarship PDF and the Global BBA Fees and Funding page: applicants must apply for a scholarship together with their application for the bachelor's, and must submit their scholarship application within one week of completing their online bachelor's application. All scholarship applications sent once candidates have received their admission result will be discarded. Scholarships are subject to availability; certain EADA scholarships that have all been awarded in previous deadlines may not be available in later deadlines.
application_deadline.deadline_warning: Do not present a single fixed scholarship deadline for this scheme. The deadline is derived from the applicant's own bachelor's application date plus one week, and from the admission round they target. Late submissions (after the admission result) are discarded, and exhausted awards may not be available in later rounds.

programme_duration.official_range: 4 years (Global BBA), with 8-12 months of internships and 1-2 years of study abroad of which one academic year abroad is mandatory
programme_duration.renewal_note: The Global BBA runs 4 years. Tuition is divided into 3 instalments per year and EADA guarantees the same tuition fee as the year of enrolment throughout the entire 4-year programme. Scholarship coverage is published per academic year, with the Scholarship for Excellence and the Athletic Scholarship covering each year spent at the Barcelona Global BBA Campus and the Global Student and Junior Talent Scholarships covering the academic year of application only.

funding.scholarship_type: Merit-based tuition-fee reduction awarded by the university and applied as a discount on tuition payments
funding.monthly_amount_note: No monthly stipend, living allowance or maintenance payment is published for these undergraduate scholarships. The award is a percentage discount on the tuition fee.
funding.travel_amount_note: No travel allowance is published. The official description of the award covers only a percentage of the annual tuition fee.
funding.institutional_costs: The programme fee does not include accommodation or meals. The tuition fee includes the academic programme and academic materials, use of all facilities at the EADA Campus 2 - Provença, access to the Knowledge & Information Centre (library), access to EADA Careers & Talent resources and activities, and participation in company visits when applicable.
funding.fully_funded_note: Not a fully funded award. Coverage is capped at 25% of the annual tuition fee (a fixed 25% for the Junior Talent Scholarship) and no living allowance, travel, insurance or installation support is published. Students must fund the remaining tuition plus accommodation and meals themselves.

tuition.percentage_of_annual_tuition: 10%-25% for the Scholarship for Excellence, Global Student Scholarship and Athletic Scholarship; a fixed 25% for the Junior Talent Scholarship
tuition.conditions: The scheme states scholarships are merit-based and cover between 10% and 25% of the 2026-2027 programme fee of the intake of application. The award is applied as a discount to the total programme fee and to the final pending payment(s) of the programme. The Scholarship for Excellence and Athletic Scholarship apply for each year the student spends at the Barcelona Global BBA Campus; the Global Student and Junior Talent Scholarships apply to the academic year of application only.
tuition.derived_range_note: Derived, not published: 10%-25% of the official 17.500 EUR 2026-27 Global BBA tuition fee equals roughly 1.750-4.375 EUR per year. EADA does not publish this figure; it is an arithmetic derivation from two official figures.

visa_support.note: Not published in official source; the admissions page advises applying early to allow ample time for the visa process, which implies no funded visa support

research_allowance.note: Not applicable / not published in official source

book_allowance.note: Not published in official source; academic materials are included in the tuition fee

equipment_allowance.note: Not applicable / not published in official source

family_allowance.note: Not published in official source. A separate 10% Family Discount and 5% Family Alumni Discount exist but are discounts, not scholarships, and cannot be stacked with a scholarship.

accommodation_support.note: Not published in official source. The official Fees and Funding page states the programme fee does not include accommodation or meals; EADA offers special rates at partner residences but publishes no accommodation scholarship for these awards.

bond.note: No financial bond or service obligation is published. All scholarship candidates must sign the Scholarship Awardee Contract and a Non-Disclosure Agreement, and recipients must maintain a GPA of 3.5 or higher. The consequences of falling below that GPA are not published.

total_estimated_value.note: EADA does not publish a total award value. The award is a percentage of the annual tuition fee, so any euro total would be a derived figure.

final_year_condition: Not applicable in the bachelor's-completion sense: this award funds a bachelor's degree and does not require a completed bachelor's. The equivalent condition at secondary level is that a copy of the high school degree is required only for candidates who have already completed it, so final-year high school students can apply and submit transcripts from their two last years of high school. Applicants must hold a minimum High School Diploma (12 years of primary and secondary education).
equivalent_degree_note: EADA requires a minimum of a High School Diploma (12 years of primary and secondary school) and explicitly accepts equivalents: Bachillerato Español, International Baccalaureate, French Baccalauréat, American High School Diploma, German Abitur, etc. For second-year entry, candidates must have obtained a high school diploma plus 60 ECTS in a degree equivalent to Business Administration, and EADA only accepts 1st year students from other universities into year 2.

eligibility.citizenship: No nationality restriction is published for these undergraduate scholarships; EADA describes cohorts of more than 100 nationalities on its Global BBA. The one published nationality-linked operational rule is that admission rounds starting after 1 June are only for EU citizens.
eligibility.secondary_school_requirement: Minimum High School Diploma covering 12 years of primary and secondary education. Accepted examples named officially: Bachillerato Español, International Baccalaureate, French Baccalauréat, American High School Diploma, Abitur.
eligibility.academic_requirements: Scholarships are merit-based for outstanding candidates who demonstrate the potential for superior performance in the programme. The Scholarship for Excellence targets an outstanding academic record and its recipients commit to maintaining a GPA of 3.5 or higher. The Spanish Bachillerato Academic Excellence Scholarship requires a final Bachillerato grade of 8,5 out of 10 or higher.
eligibility.gpa_requirement: No minimum admission GPA is published. Scholarship recipients are required to perform well in the programme, maintaining a GPA of 3.5 or higher. To study the third year abroad, all students must have passed 120 ECTS and achieved a 2.0 GPA.
eligibility.language_requirement: English. Minimum recommended score equivalent to B2 CEFR: TOEFL IBT or IELTS 6. Native speakers, or candidates who have completed at least one year of their academic journey in English, may be eligible for a waiver pending review by the Admissions Committee.
eligibility.work_experience: Not required. The Junior Talent Scholarship accepts outstanding professional experience (internships, part-time jobs, volunteering, professional projects) as evidence of talent, but no work-experience threshold is published.
eligibility.extracurricular_requirement: Exceptional extracurricular activities or outstanding professional experience are the stated profile for the Junior Talent Scholarship.
eligibility.previous_scholarship_restriction: Maximum of one EADA scholarship per candidate; scholarships and discounts do not stack, and the highest-value award is applied automatically.
eligibility.enrolment_status_requirement: Applicants must apply for the scholarship together with, and before the outcome of, the bachelor's application. To accept a scholarship, candidates are required to enrol in their chosen bachelor's programme within 2 weeks of being admitted and awarded the scholarship; the Global BBA admissions page separately states that admitted candidates have 15 days from the date of admission to enrol.
eligibility.field_restrictions: Business and management undergraduate programmes. The Spanish Bachillerato Academic Excellence Scholarship is open to students enrolled in any EADA undergraduate programme.

academic_requirements.percentage_note: No minimum high school percentage or grade is published for the general merit scholarships. The only published numeric academic threshold is the Spanish Bachillerato Academic Excellence Scholarship's final Bachillerato grade equal to or higher than 8,5 out of 10. Awardees must maintain a GPA of 3.5 or higher, which is a continuation condition rather than an admission threshold.

english_requirement.minimum_toefl: Min. 100 score for exams taken before 21 January 2026; Min. 5 score for exams taken on or after 21 January 2026 (TOEFL IBT)
english_requirement.moi_rule: Candidates who are native English speakers or who have completed at least one year of their academic journey in English may be eligible for a waiver, pending review by the Admissions Committee.
english_requirement.test_score_note: EADA describes the minimum recommended score as the equivalent to a B2 Level according to the CEFR, and lists TOEFL IBT and IELTS 6. EADA's TOEFL school code is 7024. Separately, before the end of the third semester all students must submit a valid TOEFL IBT to participate in the Mobility programme, and all students must pass 120 ECTS and achieve a 2.0 GPA to study the third year abroad. Students entering in second year must provide a TOEFL IBT.

language_of_instruction.language_note: The Global BBA and the two double-degree undergraduate programmes are taught completely in English. The scholarship motivation letter introducing yourself and explaining why you are an outstanding candidate must be written in English.

application_method.application_route: Candidates complete the online Global BBA application at apply.eada.edu, pay the 100 EUR application fee, and submit the scholarship application through the online scholarship application form included in the Global BBA online application form. The official 2026-2027 EADA Scholarship Application PDF separately instructs candidates to email the complete application package (cover page on top) to scholarshipsbba@eada.edu within one week of submitting the online bachelor's application.
application_steps: 1. Complete the online Global BBA bachelor's application at apply.eada.edu; the application is not complete until the 100 EUR application fee has been paid

2. Upload the required admission documents: copy of high school degree (if already completed), transcripts from the two last years of high school, passport photo, 2 recommendation letters, copy of foreign passport or Spanish ID, CV/Resume and Personal Statement/Cover Letter
3. Demonstrate English proficiency via a TOEFL IBT or IELTS 6, or claim the native-speaker / one-year-in-English waiver for Admissions Committee review

5. Within one week of submitting the online bachelor's application, submit the scholarship application: select the scholarship that best fits the profile, complete the Scholarship Application Coversheet and the Scholarship Awardee Contract, and write a letter (in English) introducing yourself and explaining why you are an outstanding candidate

6. Add the award-specific evidence if applying for the Global Student Scholarship (proof of having lived in several countries) or the Junior Talent Scholarship (documentation of exceptional extracurricular activities or outstanding professional experience)
7. Submit the complete package with the coversheet on top, via the online scholarship form or by email to scholarshipsbba@eada.edu, before the admission result is issued
8. Receive the admission and scholarship decision together by email
9. Enrol in the programme and pay the 10% registration fee within 2 weeks of admission to accept the scholarship, and sign the Scholarship Awardee Contract

selection_process.weighting_note: EADA does not publish any weighting, points system or ranking of selection criteria for these scholarships.

The Global BBA admissions page adds that responses typically arrive within a few days to a couple of weeks after review.

degree_outcome.awarded_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Management Sciences - Undergraduate diploma in International Business Management (DESMIE), accredited by the French Ministry of National Education, Higher Education and Research and conferring the degree of a French 'licence' (4 years of higher education - Level 6), RNCP n°40811, plus a private diploma from EADA Business School

Private diploma from EADA Business School
degree_outcome.degree_note: The Global BBA is delivered by EADA Business School and SKEMA Business School. Two semesters (one academic year) abroad are mandatory for all students. Graduating students obtain the French Ministry accredited DESMIE diploma in addition to an EADA private diploma.
degree_outcome.credit_transfer: EADA accepts students in year 1 and as transfer students in year 2. Second-year entry requires having obtained a high school diploma plus 60 ECTS at the current university in a degree equivalent to Business Administration; EADA only accepts 1st year students from other universities into year 2. All students must have passed 120 ECTS and achieved a 2.0 GPA to study the third year abroad.

student_rights_and_cost_protection.tuition_fee_for_recipients: 17.500 EUR for the 2026-27 academic year for the Global BBA, divided into 3 instalments per year. EADA guarantees the same tuition fee as the year of enrolment throughout the entire duration of the programme (4 years). EADA reserves the right to set the number of instalments available depending on the time of enrolment. The programme fee does not include accommodation or meals.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.application_fee_for_recipients: The 100 EUR application fee is not waived by the published scholarship terms; the online application is not complete until the fee is paid.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.student_agreement: All scholarship candidates must sign the Scholarship Awardee Contract, which describes the rights and duties of scholarship awardees, and a Non-Disclosure Agreement covering the amount of the scholarship (with permitted disclosure to faculty, alumni, associated companies or current students). The contract is signed by the Associate Director of Admissions.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.common_services: Academic programme and academic materials; use of all facilities at the EADA Campus 2 - Provença; access to the Knowledge & Information Centre (library) and related resources on and off campus; access to EADA Careers & Talent resources and activities; participation in company visits when applicable. EADA also offers special rates at partner residences.

practical_application_data.motivation_letter_strategy: The letter must be written in English and must introduce yourself and explain why you are an outstanding candidate for the specific scholarship you are selecting. Match the letter to the award's stated profile: an outstanding academic record and potential for superior performance for the Scholarship for Excellence; concrete evidence of having lived in several countries during your schooling years for the Global Student Scholarship; and specific, evidenced extracurricular activities or professional experience such as internships, part-time jobs, volunteering or professional projects for the Junior Talent Scholarship. Draft it before you submit the bachelor's application so you can send the package within one week.

risk_flags.risk: Deadline is relative rather than a fixed calendar date, so it is easy to miss
risk_flags.impact: The scholarship application must be submitted within one week of completing the online bachelor's application; applications sent after the admission result are discarded
risk_flags.mitigation: Prepare the full scholarship package, including the English motivation letter, before submitting the bachelor's application, and target an admission round date with time to spare

risk_flags.risk: Awards are exhausted in early rounds
risk_flags.impact: EADA states certain scholarships that have all been awarded in previous deadlines may not be available in later deadlines
risk_flags.mitigation: Apply as early as possible, ideally against the 11 December 2026 or 8 January 2027 rounds for the Fall 2027 intake, since EADA encourages applying as soon as possible to increase chances

risk_flags.risk: Coverage is capped at 25% of tuition with no living support
risk_flags.impact: A student who believes the award is fully funded would face a funding gap of roughly three quarters of the 17.500 EUR fee plus accommodation and meals
risk_flags.mitigation: Budget the remaining tuition and living costs independently and check the 15% early-bird, 10% family and 5% family alumni discounts, noting they cannot be stacked with a scholarship

risk_flags.risk: Non-stacking rule silently reduces the benefit
risk_flags.impact: A candidate holding several awards or discounts is automatically given only the single highest-value one
risk_flags.mitigation: Compare the percentage value of each available award and discount before enrolling, and choose the highest-value route deliberately

risk_flags.impact: Recipients are required to maintain a GPA of 3.5 or higher; the published documents do not state the consequence of falling below it
risk_flags.mitigation: Confirm the academic consequences with the Admissions Department before signing the Scholarship Awardee Contract

risk_flags.impact: The 2026-2027 official scholarship PDF names the award 'Scholarship for Excellence' while the official Global BBA Fees and Funding page names it 'Scholarship for Academic Excellence', and the generic application form PDF still cites the 2023-24 fee year
risk_flags.mitigation: Select the scholarship by its stated profile and coverage band rather than by name alone, and confirm the current fee year with the Admissions Department

risk_flags.risk: Coverage may not extend beyond the academic year of application
risk_flags.impact: Only the Scholarship for Excellence and Athletic Scholarship are documented as covering each year at the Barcelona Global BBA Campus; the Global Student and Junior Talent Scholarships cover the academic year of application only
risk_flags.mitigation: Prefer the Scholarship for Excellence or Athletic Scholarship if multi-year coverage is needed, and confirm renewal in writing before accepting

risk_flags.risk: Admission rounds after 1 June are restricted to EU citizens
risk_flags.impact: Non-EU candidates relying on late summer rounds may be unable to use them and may face a rushed visa process
risk_flags.mitigation: Non-EU applicants should target an early round such as 11 December 2026 to 4 June 2027 to allow time for the visa process

database_notes: No substitution was needed. The assigned target (EADA Business School Barcelona undergraduate scholarships) is hosted in Spain, an allowed region, is not on the do-not-duplicate list in RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md, and funds a bachelor's degree.

The task referred to a 'scholarships-for-undergraduates' page. EADA has no page at that exact path (it returns 404). The equivalent official page is the Global BBA 'Fees and Funding' page, which is where EADA publishes 'EADA scholarships: the basics' and the full list of undergraduate scholarships; that page is therefore used as official_source_url.

Award name discrepancy recorded honestly: the official 2026-2027 EADA Scholarship Application Undergraduate Programmes PDF names the award 'Scholarship for Excellence', while the official Global BBA Fees and Funding page names the same-profile award 'Scholarship for Academic Excellence'. The title in this record uses the scheme name; the PDF name is used in the award list and the webpage variant is recorded as a legacy title.

The 2026-2027 PDF lists four awards (Scholarship for Excellence, Global Student Scholarship, Junior Talent Scholarship, Athletic Scholarship). The official web page lists five, adding the Spanish Bachillerato Academic Excellence Scholarship, which is not in the PDF. All five are recorded with their source noted.
Coverage bands are per award, not a single scheme-wide band, and the overall statement is 'between 10% and 25% of the 2026-2027 programme fee'. Each award's band is quoted exactly as published.

Two application routes are published and both are recorded: the Global BBA Fees and Funding page says the scholarship application form is available and included in the online application form for the Global BBA, while the official 2026-2027 PDF instructs candidates to email the complete package to scholarshipsbba@eada.edu. Candidates should confirm the current route with the Admissions Department.

Two enrolment windows are published and differ: the scholarship PDF and the Fees and Funding page state 2 weeks from being admitted/awarded, while the Global BBA Admissions page states admitted candidates have 15 days from the date of admission to enrol. Both are quoted; the 2-week rule is used as the scholarship acceptance condition because it is the one stated in the scholarship documents.

Two results-timing statements are published and differ: the scholarship PDF says within 1 week of the corresponding admission deadline, while the Fees and Funding page says within 10 days of completing the admissions process. Both are recorded.

The admission-rounds calendar for the Fall 2027 intake was read directly from the Global BBA Admissions page: rounds on 11 December 2026, 8 January 2027, 5 February 2027, 5 March 2027, 9 April 2027, 23 April 2027, 7 May 2027, 21 May 2027, 4 June 2027, 18 June 2027, 2 July 2027, 16 July 2027 and 30 July 2027, with corresponding enrolment deadlines of 31 December 2026 (15% early-bird discount), 28 January 2027, 25 February 2027, 25 March 2027, 23 April 2027, 13 May 2027, 27 May 2027, 10 June 2027, 24 June 2027, 4 July 2027, 18 July 2027, 30 July 2027 and 6 August 2027.

The Early Action / EA1 / EA2 / RD round labels requested in the task are not used by EADA on any official page fetched. EADA uses undated-name rolling admission rounds published as explicit calendar dates. This is recorded as an unverified/removed claim rather than fabricated.

Rolling-deadline availability is confirmed by the official statement that EADA follows a rolling admission policy for its Bachelor Programmes allowing applicants to apply at any time, with admission rounds every 15 days, typically on Fridays, and weekly rounds in August.

bachelor_requirement is set to false because this award funds a bachelor's degree and does not require an already-completed bachelor's degree; the required entry qualification is a High School Diploma. final_year_bachelor_allowed is false for the same reason, with the secondary-level equivalent explained in final_year_condition.
final_year_condition and the secondary school rules follow the schema instruction that for bachelor's awards these fields describe secondary/high school completion.
age_limit, nationality_quota, gender_restriction and previous_emjm scholarship restrictions are set to null/false because nothing is published on these points; no age cap was invented.

citizenship_restriction is false: the general undergraduate scholarships publish no nationality restriction. The Spanish Bachillerato Academic Excellence Scholarship is restricted by qualification obtained (a Spanish Bachillerato grade), not by nationality, so it does not make the scheme nationality-restricted.
worldwide_eligibility is true: no nationality restriction is published for these scholarships and EADA describes Global BBA cohorts of more than 100 nationalities.

The 15% early-bird discount, 10% family discount and 5% family alumni discount are discounts, not scholarships, and cannot be stacked with a scholarship. They are recorded as context only and were not counted as scholarship coverage. The published early-bird deadline of 31 December 2025 has already passed for the current cycle.

The tuition fee of 17.500 EUR is the official 2026-27 Global BBA fee and is published on the Global BBA Fees and Funding page. EADA guarantees the same tuition fee as the year of enrolment for the full 4 years, but reserves the right to change the number of instalments depending on the time of enrolment.

A derived coverage range of roughly 1.750-4.375 EUR per year (10%-25% of 17.500 EUR) is mentioned only in funding_breakdown.tuition.derived_range_note and is explicitly labelled as an arithmetic derivation from two official figures, not an EADA-published award value.

The generic scholarship application form PDF linked from the Fees and Funding page still cites the 2023-24 programme fee and lists only three awards, so it was used only for the form structure (coversheet, awardee contract, letter, award-specific evidence) and not for the current fee year or the current award list. The 2026-2027 PDF is the authoritative cycle document.

The logo is taken from EADA's official media kit and brand guidelines on the eada.edu domain (horizontal positive PNG), verified by HTTP HEAD returning 200 with image/png and 235914 bytes. A the-domain favicon-style mark and a small footer logo also exist on eada.edu, but the media kit asset is used because it comes from the official brand asset library. logo_url is therefore a verified official asset, not null.
